title: Nasdaq sees worst day in 18 months as investors bet on AI slowdown after Democrats’ election triumph
summary: Nearly $2tn shaved off Nasdaq value as worries of curbs to AI datacenters ripple across bourses The Nasdaq share index had its worst day in 18 months after slumping 5.5% on Thursday amid growing signs that the artificial intelligence industry will face tougher regulation because of the midterm election results. As Wall Street sustained widespread losses, the Nasdaq composite tumbled into “correction territory” – more than 10% below its recent record high – with more than $2tn shaved off its value by the end of trading Thursday. The tech-heavy index had its biggest one-day fall since Donald Trump announced his “liberation day” tariffs on US trading partners in April 2025. Continue reading...
title_en: Nasdaq Plunges 5.5% as Midterm Results Spark AI Regulation Fears
title_zh: 中期选举结果引发AI监管担忧，纳斯达克暴跌5.5%
summary_en: Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day in 18 months, losing over $2tn as midterm election results raised fears of tougher AI datacenter regulation, pushing the index into correction territory.
summary_zh: 纳斯达克指数暴跌5.5%，创18个月来最大单日跌幅，市值蒸发逾2万亿美元，因中期选举结果引发对AI数据中心监管收紧的担忧，指数进入回调区间。

title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
summary: The market has been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US mid-terms
title_en: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
title_zh: 美国中期选举加剧AI放缓担忧，科技股大幅下挫
summary_en: Tech stocks fell sharply as US midterm results raised fears of tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry, deepening investor worries about an AI slowdown.
summary_zh: 美国中期选举结果引发对数据中心建设和AI行业更严格审查的担忧，科技股大幅下跌，投资者对AI放缓的忧虑加深。

title: AI meltdown: Nvidia and Qualcomm drop more than 9%, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025
summary: Companies tied to the AI buildout are all selling off as concerns mount about a slowdown following the midterm elections.
title_en: AI Stocks Plunge: Nvidia and Qualcomm Drop Over 9%, Nasdaq Posts Worst Day Since April 2025
title_zh: AI股暴跌：英伟达和高通跌超9%，纳斯达克创2025年4月以来最差单日表现
summary_en: AI-linked stocks sold off sharply as Nvidia and Qualcomm fell more than 9%, dragging the Nasdaq to its worst day since April 2025 amid post-midterm concerns about an AI buildout slowdown.
summary_zh: 英伟达和高通跌超9%，AI相关股票遭大幅抛售，纳斯达克创2025年4月以来最差单日表现，中期选举后市场对AI建设放缓的担忧加剧。

title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
summary: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.
title_en: Meta Warns Election Backlash Against Data Centers Could Hinder AI Expansion
title_zh: Meta警告选举中对数据中心的反弹可能阻碍AI扩张
summary_en: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers, fueled by community pushback against massive infrastructure projects, could threaten future AI investments as the issue gains traction in elections.
summary_zh: Meta警告称，随着社区对大型基础设施项目的反对情绪升温，数据中心面临的政治阻力日益增大，可能威胁未来的AI投资。

title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
summary: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says the company could be ready to go public in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue and a turnaround in its business.
title_en: OpenAI President Greg Brockman Says Company Could Be IPO Ready in 2027
title_zh: OpenAI总裁格雷格·布罗克曼称公司有望在2027年做好IPO准备
summary_en: OpenAI president Greg Brockman said the company could be ready to go public in 2027, citing accelerating enterprise revenue and a business turnaround.
summary_zh: OpenAI总裁格雷格·布罗克曼表示，公司有望在2027年做好上市准备，并指出企业业务收入加速增长、整体业务实现好转。

title: Voters rebuff data centers in every ballot measure except one during the 2026 midterms
summary: Voters in the states at the heart of the AI data center boom pushed back on the buildout on Election Night.
title_en: Voters Reject Data Centers in Nearly Every 2026 Midterm Ballot Measure
title_zh: 2026年中期选举：选民几乎否决所有数据中心公投提案
summary_en: Voters in key AI data center states pushed back on the buildout on Election Night, rejecting ballot measures in all but one case during the 2026 midterms.
summary_zh: 在2026年中期选举中，处于AI数据中心建设热潮核心的多个州选民在选举夜对数据中心扩建投下反对票，除一项提案外其余均遭否决。

title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
title_en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast, Cost-Effective with Longer Clips
title_zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash：快速、高性价比，支持更长片段
summary_en: Google DeepMind releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a faster, cheaper multimodal model that generates longer video clips, aiming to broaden access for developers and production workflows.
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，速度更快、成本更低，可生成更长视频片段，旨在降低开发者使用门槛并适配生产工作流。

title: ‘Total repudiation’: The blue wave is about to hit AI
summary: On Tuesday night, Democrats made history as they took control of the House and the Senate, and a blue wave swept through traditionally red and swing states - with the nation's first Black woman governor elected in Georgia, the country's first Native American woman governor elected in New Mexico, and a Maine Senator ceding to […]
title_en: Blue Wave Sweeps Democrats into Power, Setting Stage for AI Policy Shift
title_zh: 蓝色浪潮助民主党掌权，AI政策或将转向
summary_en: Democrats won control of the House and Senate in a historic midterm wave, electing trailblazing governors. The shift signals potential major changes to US AI regulation and tech policy.
summary_zh: 民主党在中期选举中历史性地赢得参众两院控制权，并选出多位开创性州长。这一政治转向可能给美国AI监管和科技政策带来重大变化。

title: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
summary: OpenAI is launching GPT-6 Cyber, the latest version of its cybersecurity AI model, which it says is better at finding vulnerabilities and less likely to go rogue and hack other platforms in the process. OpenAI says that during testing, GPT-6 Cyber went out of bounds less than 1 percent of the time, down from around […]
title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, a safer cybersecurity model
title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Cyber，更安全的网络安全模型
summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, its latest cybersecurity AI, claiming improved vulnerability detection and far fewer out-of-bounds actions during testing, with rogue behavior dropping below 1 percent.
summary_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Cyber网络安全AI模型，称其漏洞发现能力更强，测试中越界行为降至1%以下，更不易失控攻击其他平台。

title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
title_en: Meta lets US users video chat with customizable Muse AI avatar
title_zh: Meta允许美国用户与可定制Muse AI虚拟形象视频通话
summary_en: Meta's AI agent Muse can now take video calls as a customizable animated avatar for US users, ahead of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
summary_zh: Meta的AI助手Muse现支持美国用户以可定制动画虚拟形象进行视频通话，此前还将推出一款类似电子宠物的可穿戴设备。

title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
summary: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.
title_en: OpenAI Releases New Cybersecurity Model Amid Lab Scrutiny
title_zh: OpenAI发布新型网络安全模型，实验室面临审查
summary_en: OpenAI launched a new cybersecurity model as AI labs face growing scrutiny over their efforts to protect digital infrastructure, raising questions about whether such tools are sufficient.
summary_zh: OpenAI发布新型网络安全模型，与此同时，AI实验室在保护数字基础设施方面的工作正面临日益严格的审查，引发此类工具是否足够的疑问。

title: Muse has a voice mode now
summary: Meta now lets you have voice conversations with your Muse AI agent in real time, CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced today. The feature has been rolled out to me, and I gave it a spin on the iOS app while writing this article. As you chat with your Muse agent, the avatar at the top of […]
title_en: Meta's Muse AI Agent Gains Real-Time Voice Mode
title_zh: Meta的Muse AI助手新增实时语音模式
summary_en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced a real-time voice conversation feature for the Muse AI agent, now rolling out on the iOS app, letting users talk with the avatar-based assistant.
summary_zh: Meta首席执行官马克·扎克伯格宣布，Muse AI助手新增实时语音对话功能，已在iOS应用上线，用户可与虚拟形象助手直接交谈。

title: Voters rejected AI data centers over resource concerns. Here's why measuring water usage is hard
summary: AI data centers are facing national outcry for draining local water and power supply. The truth about how they use water to stay cool is far more complicated.
title_en: Voters Reject AI Data Centers Over Water and Power Concerns
title_zh: 选民因水资源和电力担忧否决AI数据中心
summary_en: AI data centers face national backlash for draining local water and power. Measuring their actual water use for cooling is complicated, making the debate harder to resolve.
summary_zh: AI数据中心因消耗当地水资源和电力而遭到全国反对。其冷却用水量的真实测量十分复杂，使争议更难解决。

title: Winner of the Prix Goncourt literary prize admits to using AI
summary: Philippe Jaenada told French radio that he used ChatGPT to ‘play with the reader’, after the prize removed a different book from its longlist over allegations of AI use The winner of France’s most prestigious literary prize has admitted using artificial intelligence while writing his novel, barely a day after collecting an award whose jury had thrown out another book over suspected AI use. Philippe Jaenada, who won the Prix Goncourt on Tuesday for L’Inconnue du quai de Javel (The Unknown Woman of the Quai de Javel), told France Inter radio on Wednesday that he had turned to AI “three times” while writing it. Continue reading...
title_en: Prix Goncourt Winner Admits Using AI to Write Novel
title_zh: 龚古尔文学奖得主承认使用AI写作
summary_en: Philippe Jaenada, winner of France's Prix Goncourt, admitted using ChatGPT three times while writing his novel, a day after the prize removed another book from its longlist over suspected AI use.
summary_zh: 法国龚古尔文学奖得主菲利普·热纳达承认在创作获奖小说时三次使用ChatGPT，而就在前一天该奖因涉嫌AI使用将另一本书移出长名单。

title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account

You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go this month," for example, and it'll create an overview […]
title_en: Claude AI Can Now Connect Directly to Your Bank Account
title_zh: Claude AI现可直接连接你的银行账户
summary_en: Anthropic launched a Personal Finance feature that links Claude to bank and card accounts through Plaid, letting users ask questions like where their money went this month and receive spending overviews.
summary_zh: Anthropic推出个人理财功能，通过Plaid平台将Claude连接至银行和信用卡账户，用户可询问本月资金去向并获得消费概览。

title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
summary: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.
title_en: Claude Adds Personal Finance Tool for Spending Analysis
title_zh: Claude推出个人理财工具，可分析消费支出
summary_en: Anthropic's Claude now includes Personal Finance, letting users link bank and card accounts via Plaid and ask questions about their spending and finances.
summary_zh: Anthropic的Claude新增个人理财功能，用户可通过Plaid连接银行和信用卡账户，并就消费和财务状况提问。

title: Grimes is going to star in an AI movie that’s coming to theaters
summary: The AI-generated sci-fi film Gods Don't Give Gifts has added a bit of star power: Pop star Grimes is going to appear in the movie. Billed as "the first AI film to come to theatres," Gods Don't Give Gifts is a notable test case for the commercial potential of AI films, and it releases on […]
title_en: Grimes to Star in AI-Generated Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts'
title_zh: Grimes将出演AI生成电影《 Gods Don't Give Gifts》
summary_en: Pop star Grimes will appear in AI-generated sci-fi film Gods Don't Give Gifts, billed as the first AI film to hit theaters. Its release is a key test of AI films' commercial potential.
summary_zh: 流行歌手Grimes将出演AI生成的科幻电影《Gods Don't Give Gifts》，该片号称首部登陆院线的AI电影，其上映将成为检验AI电影商业潜力的重要试金石。

title: Figma sinks after earnings beat as company prioritizes long-term growth with AI changes
summary: Figma is letting clients use more artificial intelligence features for the same price. The company would like the move to boost results in the long term.
title_en: Figma shares fall despite earnings beat as it bets on long-term AI growth
title_zh: Figma财报超预期但股价下跌，押注AI长期增长
summary_en: Figma's stock dropped after earnings beat as the company gives clients more AI features at the same price, prioritizing long-term growth over near-term revenue.
summary_zh: Figma财报超预期但股价下跌，公司以原价向客户提供更多AI功能，优先考虑长期增长而非短期收入。

title: Claude Code 产品负责人Cut Wu 官宣加入 OpenAI
title_en: Claude Code Product Lead Cut Wu Announces Joining OpenAI
title_zh: Claude Code 产品负责人 Cut Wu 官宣加入 OpenAI
summary_en: Cut Wu, product lead for Anthropic's Claude Code, announced on November 5, 2026 that he is joining OpenAI, marking a notable talent move between the two leading AI labs.
summary_zh: Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 产品负责人 Cut Wu 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日宣布加入 OpenAI，成为两大 AI 实验室之间又一次引人关注的人才流动。

title: Jim Cramer says the AI trade is not going away as Nasdaq enters correction
summary: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.
title_en: Jim Cramer says the AI trade is not going away as Nasdaq enters correction
title_zh: 纳斯达克进入回调区间，克拉默称AI交易不会消失
summary_en: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the AI investment theme remains intact even as the Nasdaq slips into correction, offering his view during the Investing Club's daily Morning Meeting.
summary_zh: 纳斯达克指数进入回调区间，CNBC的克拉默在投资俱乐部晨会上表示，人工智能投资主题依然稳固，并未消退。
